canonical_strategy: Competitive Agent V2 = Economic Planner V1 (frozen) + Phase 3.3 Variant D market response (frozen) + Phase 3.5 competitive scaling response (new, validated this phase).
entry_point: main.py (repo root), module-level agent(obs) function, per AGENTS.md's documented submission contract.
package_format: tar.gz, main.py at the archive root, per AGENTS.md's documented multi-file submission format
what_changed_from_submission_A: 5 new files added: agents/phase3_5/__init__.py, agents/phase3_5/opponent_scaling_detector.py, agents/phase3_5/response_policy.py, agents/phase3_5/adapters/__init__.py, agents/phase3_5/adapters/competitive_v2_agent.py
Zero changes to Planner v1, Variant D's own interventions.py, or expansion_detector.py -- V2 wraps them unmodified

validation_performed.regression_tests: 106/106 passing (86 pre-existing through Phase 3.5's own submission-packaging tests + 20 new Phase 3.5 research/countermeasure tests)
validation_performed.planner_v1_control_reproduction: 30/30 exact byte-for-byte matches, re-run after all Phase 3.5 changes
validation_performed.variant_d_inside_v2_reproduction: 10/15 win rate against expansion_oriented on Variant D's original validated 15-seed battery, with money values matching the Phase 3.3 reference EXACTLY on every seed -- confirms V2's market-response layer is unmodified
validation_performed.v2_byte_identical_when_inactive: confirmed against all 6 non-scaling archetypes (passive, production_heavy, market_selling, animal_oriented, conservative, aggressive_investment) -- 0 activations, byte-identical to Planner v1 control
validation_performed.scaling_countermeasure_validation: development (4 seeds) + validation (5 seeds) + held_out (6 seeds) = 15/15 against the controlled heavy_scaler archetype, consistent large positive margin improvement (+$12k-18k per episode) in every seed, 100% detector activation rate, zero false positives against the other archetypes
validation_performed.fresh_environment_validation: minimal file tree (30 files, 428KB) copied outside the repo, cold Python process, kaggle_environments' own registered environment
validation_performed.actual_package_validation: the real built tar.gz was extracted to a fresh location and run end-to-end -- full 720-turn episode, status=DONE both players, no crashes
validation_performed.multi_episode_state_isolation: 3 consecutive episodes in the same process produced consistent results

known_limitations: heavy_scaler (the synthetic archetype used to validate the new countermeasure) does not fully replicate real losing opponents' WINNING margin -- it still loses to the unmodified Planner v1 control in every tested seed. The countermeasure was validated to substantially increase OUR OWN revenue capture against sustained high-labor/animal opponents, but has not been tested against a synthetic opponent that actually defeats us via this mechanism the way real opponents did.

4 of 10 real losses (L004, L006, L007, L009 -- modest_opponent_crop_choice_advantage) remain UNKNOWN/unaddressed this phase -- plausibly related to Phase 3.4's self_inflicted_narrow_market_price_crash occurring without an expansion_oriented-style opponent to trigger detection, but not experimentally isolated.
The Phase 3.4 self_inflicted_narrow_market_price_crash limitation itself remains open (Variant D's mechanism is reused unmodified inside V2).

Only 18 real competition episodes were available for forensics -- the scaling-detector thresholds (hands>=5, animals>=5) are principled round numbers reflecting the observed magnitude gap, not fit/tuned against these episodes, but also not validated against a larger real sample.

Submission A's actual Kaggle rating trajectory (declining from 600) was NOT used as a target metric or tuning signal this phase, per the brief's explicit instruction not to chase the leaderboard -- Submission B's real evaluation is the next source of evidence, not an offline proxy for it.
exact_build_process: 1. Real-competition forensics on COMPETITION RESULTS/ (18 episodes) -> results/phase3_5/competition_results_inventory.json, trajectories/, differential_summary.json, win_analysis.json, failure_knowledge_base.json
2. Design agents/phase3_5/opponent_scaling_detector.py (rule-based, public-observation-only) and agents/phase3_5/response_policy.py (labor/animal target override)
4. Build agents/phase3_5/adapters/competitive_v2_agent.py (Planner v1 + Variant D + scaling response, sequential disjoint-key overrides)
5. Stage-1 screen on development seeds, then full development+validation+held_out gate (scripts/phase3_5_run_v2_experiments.py)
6. Side-effect check against all 6 non-scaling archetypes + Variant D's original expansion_oriented battery
10. Update main.py to build Competitive Agent V2
12. Extract the built tar.gz to a location outside the repo and run a full 720-turn episode via kaggle_environments from a cold process -- confirms the ACTUAL package works standalone
